title: Structural, morphological, electrochemical, and supercapacitance capability of NiCoMoO4-doped MoS2 nanoplates
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16229-16239
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01168J, Paper

This article investigates the structural, morphological, and electrochemical properties of NiCoMoO4-doped MoS2 nanoplates, highlighting their enhanced supercapacitor performance and potential applications in energy storage devices.
